name: National parks
title: National park holidays in the USA and Canada
intro: Canyons, geysers, glaciers, giant trees and bears catching salmon. Here's how to choose a national park in the USA or Canada, when to go and which ones to put together on one trip.
seo_title: National parks in the USA and Canada: which to visit and when

sections.heading: The best national parks for a first visit
sections.text:
If it's your first time, pick a park with big sights close to the road and a town nearby for food and beds.

- **[Yellowstone](/destinations/yellowstone):** geysers, hot springs and bison everywhere, with [Grand Teton](/destinations/grand-teton-national-park) right next door.
- **[Grand Canyon](/destinations/grand-canyon):** the viewpoints along the South Rim are a short walk from the car or the free shuttle.
- **[Yosemite](/destinations/yosemite-national-park):** waterfalls and granite cliffs, with easy flat walks on the valley floor.
- **[Zion](/destinations/zion-national-park):** a free shuttle up the canyon and river walks for all ages.
- **[Banff](/destinations/banff) and [Jasper](/destinations/jasper-national-park):** turquoise lakes, glaciers and the Icefields Parkway between them.
- **[Great Smoky Mountains](/destinations/great-smoky-mountains-national-park):** free to visit, with waterfalls, black bears and Dollywood nearby.

sections.heading: Parks to put together on one trip
sections.text:
National parks in the American West are often a few hours apart, so a road trip of two weeks can take in four or five.

- **Utah and Arizona:** fly into Las Vegas for [Zion](/destinations/zion-national-park), [Bryce Canyon](/destinations/bryce-canyon-national-park), [Capitol Reef](/destinations/capitol-reef-national-park), [Arches](/destinations/arches-national-park), [Canyonlands](/destinations/canyonlands-national-park) and the [Grand Canyon](/destinations/grand-canyon). Our guide to [Utah's national parks](/destinations/utah-national-parks) has the loop.
- **California:** [Yosemite](/destinations/yosemite-national-park), [Sequoia](/destinations/sequoia-national-park) and [Kings Canyon](/destinations/kings-canyon-national-park) are close together, with [Death Valley](/destinations/death-valley-national-park) and [Joshua Tree](/destinations/joshua-tree-national-park) in the desert to the south.
- **The Rockies:** [Yellowstone](/destinations/yellowstone) and [Grand Teton](/destinations/grand-teton-national-park) together, or [Glacier](/destinations/glacier-national-park) with [Waterton Lakes](/destinations/waterton-lakes-national-park) just over the Canadian border.
- **The Canadian Rockies:** [Banff](/destinations/banff), [Yoho](/destinations/yoho-national-park) and [Jasper](/destinations/jasper-national-park) from Calgary.
- **Alaska:** [Denali](/destinations/denali-national-park) and [Kenai Fjords](/destinations/kenai-fjords-national-park) by road or rail from Anchorage.
- **Canada's east coast:** [Fundy](/destinations/fundy-national-park), [Prince Edward Island](/destinations/prince-edward-island-national-park) and [Cape Breton Highlands](/destinations/cape-breton-highlands-national-park).

sections.heading: When to go
sections.text:
Most mountain parks are at their best from June to September, when the snow has melted from the high roads. Some, like [Glacier](/destinations/glacier-national-park), [Crater Lake](/destinations/crater-lake-national-park) and [Lassen](/destinations/lassen-volcanic-national-park), only open fully in July.

Desert parks are the other way round. [Death Valley](/destinations/death-valley-national-park), [Joshua Tree](/destinations/joshua-tree-national-park), [Saguaro](/destinations/saguaro-national-park) and [Big Bend](/destinations/big-bend-national-park) are best from October to April and dangerously hot in summer. [The Everglades](/destinations/everglades-national-park) is best in the dry season from December to April.

The Utah parks, [Arches](/destinations/arches-national-park) and the [Grand Canyon](/destinations/grand-canyon) are at their best in spring and autumn, though summer works if you walk early and late.

sections.heading: Passes and reservations
sections.text:
If you're visiting three or more US national parks, an America the Beautiful annual pass usually works out cheaper than paying at each gate. In Canada, a Parks Canada Discovery Pass covers every national park for a year.

The busiest parks now ask you to book ahead in summer. In recent years that's included timed entry at [Arches](/destinations/arches-national-park), [Rocky Mountain](/destinations/rocky-mountain-national-park), [Glacier](/destinations/glacier-national-park) and [Mount Rainier](/destinations/mount-rainier-national-park), a permit lottery for Angels Landing in [Zion](/destinations/zion-national-park) and sunrise reservations at [Haleakalā](/destinations/haleakala-national-park). Rules change every year, so check each park's website before you go.

faqs.question: Which national park is best for families?
faqs.answer: Yellowstone, Yosemite, Zion, the Grand Canyon, Banff and the Great Smoky Mountains are all brilliant with children, as the big sights are close to the road and there are easy walks and Junior Ranger badges.

faqs.question: How many national parks are there in the USA and Canada?
faqs.answer: The USA has 63 national parks, and Canada has 48 national parks and national park reserves. Many more areas, like national monuments and provincial parks, are protected too.

faqs.question: Do you need a car to visit national parks?
faqs.answer: Almost always. A few parks, like Zion, Yosemite and Denali, have shuttles or buses inside, but you usually need a car to get there and between them.

faqs.question: What is the best month to visit national parks?
faqs.answer: For mountain parks, July to September. For desert parks, October to April. Spring and autumn suit the canyons of Utah and Arizona, and they're quieter than the summer holidays.

faqs.question: Will we see bears?
faqs.answer: In many parks, yes. Yellowstone, Grand Teton, Glacier, Banff, Jasper, Denali and Katmai have grizzlies, and the Great Smoky Mountains has lots of black bears. Carry bear spray, make noise on trails and keep well back.
